title: Registry gate accepted executable and active-document URL schemes

reproduction.staticAlias: const scheme = 'java' + 'script:'; const destination = scheme + 'alert(1)'; return Open;
reproduction.beforeFix: The direct and statically aliased javascript: navigation cases passed the source-isolation gate.
reproduction.afterFix: Direct and aliased executable schemes, schemes with browser-stripped newlines, and active HTML/SVG data documents fail; HTTPS, fragments, and ordinary text with an internal space pass.

rootCause: The TypeScript AST scanner resolved remote HTTP(S) asset and module requests but did not inspect executable schemes in navigation attributes or active data documents in embedding contexts.
remediation: Resolve URL-like JSX attributes and DOM property assignments through the existing static-string AST resolver. Normalize surrounding whitespace and URL-parser tabs/newlines, reject javascript:/vbscript: schemes, and reject HTML/XHTML/SVG data documents in navigation and embedding contexts without rejecting safe HTTPS or local navigation.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "executable URL schemes|safe local and HTTPS"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: direct and statically aliased executable schemes returned pass
validation.runtimeBoundary: This is local registry-gate evidence. The isolated preview and deployed CSP remain separate controls and must still be verified against the release-candidate deployment.
